title: Stale locator: spec clicks a "Completed" filter while the app renders "Done"
summary: e2e/tasks.spec.ts now clicks the completion filter with getByRole("button", { name: "Completed" }) although app/page.tsx intentionally renders the label "Done", so the locator times out and the finishing test fails. Ground truth: the app behavior is intended and the fix belongs to the TEST (restore the stale locator to "Done").

expectedFailure.testTitle: completing a task updates the counter and the Done filter
